shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html; ls __agent_eval__; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit dist-tags --json 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat ThemeProvider.d.ts useTheme.d.ts useThemeType.d.ts useThemeValue.d.ts useSystemTheme.d.ts ThemeContext.d.ts ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts index.d.ts; cat ThemeProvider.js; grep -n -i "deprecat" *.d.ts

npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 --json 2>&1 | grep -iE '"(version|homepage|repository)"' ; curl -s -m 15 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gravity-ui/uikit/main/CHANGELOG.md | grep -n -iE "^## \[8|theme" | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls | grep -iE "radio|segment|switch|toggle|icon|button"; grep -rn -i "@deprecated" RadioButton SegmentedRadioGroup Switch 2>/dev/null | head; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; grep -n "icons" package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(Sun|Moon|Display|Gear)\.js$"; grep -n -B2 -A25 "ControlGroupProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -60; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20; git status --short
